about: The host moves of Sirius in Turm und Genossin, der Talk (plan "TWENTY ONE Radio", P16; user 2026-10-13: the host's phrases must be very extensive for lots of variance). Written for the show as a parody of an interrupting talk show host's STYLE (dramaturgy rule host-interrupts, resources/data/voice/talkshow.json); none of them is a quote of a real person, none names a real host. TalkShow::hostMoves() offers a rotating sample per episode (one per group first, the ones offered longest ago first) and never a move said on air within `tv.commentary.repeat_hours` (SpokenMemory); the host may also invent new ones in the same style.
